trailhead.label: Pederoa, opposite the Pizzeria Traföi, the board’s start

cautions: About 3.5 km on a road with little traffic up to Picedac: keep your dog close.
Farm tracks past working farms: watch for tractors and farm dogs.
The path back runs beside the river.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
